profile.headline: Software Engineer at Apple
profile.summary:
* 10 years of experience in whole software life cycle including requirement analysis, system architecture design and implementation.
* Developing client/server application on Windows and Linux.
* Specialized in high-volume, fault-tolerant and distributed server architecture.

Specialties: Network and multi-thread programming, Distributed computing, Code analysis and performance tuning

positions.title: Principal Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: As a team member of infrastructure team, trying to build messaging route infrastructure over XMPP.

positions.title: Chief Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed a virtual stock trading engine in Java that handles massive market streaming data from the Stock Exchanges and matches orders in real-time. Used proven messaging system in order to achieve high reliability, availability and scalability.
- Managed and resolved database design issues during development stage. Wrote stored procedures used by application logic.
- Implemented group feature to provide community service in Ruby on Rails 
- Deployed and configured web site using Apache/NginX + Thin + MySQL on Amazon EC2 to save operation cost and scale well.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Involved in designing overall distributed server architecture.
- Designed and implemented event-based application framework with thread-pooling and core network I/O engine using asynchronous I/O techniques working on windows and linux
- Implemented game instance management structure.
- Refactored reliable UDP library.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Analyzed and researched distributed server architecture for online game. (4/2006 ~ 12/2006)
* Design and implement inter-server data communication framework
* Design and implement Database gateway 
* Design server configuration manager and patch system with bug tracking

- Lead server Programmer in yoguring project (2004.1 ~ 2006.3)
* Led a team of 4 in developing and maintaing servers for an online game served in South Korea, Japan and Thailand.
* Designed overall server architecture and implemented a component manages game instances and NPC.
* Involved in designing billing system handles micro transactions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Participated in the whole software life cycle of launching a casual game portal, which is one of the most popular in South Korea.
- Responsible for development of a load-balancing server and inter-server communication framework.
- Managed and supported the third-party mobile game providers.
- Key role in developing and tuning up the application framework and core network I/O engine.
- Implemented a server gathers statistics about usage information in real-time for Interactive TV service with a cable broadcast.
- Developed a gateway converts the protocol over Mobitex to the application level protocol and an e-mail proxy supports POP.
